title: एकोनषष्टितमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 59 · Balarama's anger and Krishna's defence

summary.en: Seeing Duryodhana struck below the waist, Balarama raises his plough in rage, and Krishna restrains him. Krishna argues that Bhima has kept his vow and that Duryodhana's own wrongs and the curse of Maitreya made this fall just.
summary.kn: ದುರ್ಯೋಧನನಿಗೆ ಸೊಂಟದ ಕೆಳಗೆ ಹೊಡೆದುದನ್ನು ಕಂಡ ಬಲರಾಮ ಕೋಪದಿಂದ ನೇಗಿಲು ಎತ್ತುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಕೃಷ್ಣ ತಡೆಯುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಭೀಮ ಪ್ರತಿಜ್ಞೆ ಉಳಿಸಿಕೊಂಡನೆಂದೂ ದುರ್ಯೋಧನನ ದೋಷ ಮತ್ತು ಮೈತ್ರೇಯನ ಶಾಪದಿಂದ ಈ ಪತನ ನ್ಯಾಯವೆಂದೂ ಕೃಷ್ಣ ವಾದಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: दुर्योधन पर कमर के नीचे प्रहार देखकर बलराम क्रोध से हल उठाते हैं और कृष्ण उन्हें रोकते हैं। कृष्ण तर्क देते हैं कि भीम ने प्रतिज्ञा निभाई और दुर्योधन के अपने दोषों तथा मैत्रेय के शाप से यह पतन उचित है।
summary.te: దుర్యోధనునికి నడుము కింద దెబ్బ తగలడం చూసి బలరాముడు కోపంతో నాగలి ఎత్తుతాడు; కృష్ణుడు ఆపుతాడు. భీముడు ప్రతిజ్ఞ నిలబెట్టుకున్నాడని, దుర్యోధనుని స్వదోషాలు, మైత్రేయ శాపం వల్ల ఈ పతనం న్యాయమని కృష్ణుడు వాదిస్తాడు.
summary.ta: துரியோதனன் இடுப்புக்குக் கீழே அடிபடுவதைக் கண்ட பலராமன் சினத்துடன் கலப்பையை உயர்த்த, கண்ணன் தடுக்கிறார். பீமன் சபதத்தைக் காத்தான், துரியோதனனின் குற்றங்களாலும் மைத்ரேயரின் சாபத்தாலும் இவ்வீழ்ச்சி நியாயமே என்று கண்ணன் வாதிடுகிறார்.
summary.ml: അരക്കെട്ടിനു താഴെ ദുര്യോധനൻ പ്രഹരമേറ്റത് കണ്ട് ബലരാമൻ കോപത്തോടെ കലപ്പ ഉയർത്തുന്നു; കൃഷ്ണൻ അദ്ദേഹത്തെ തടയുന്നു. ഭീമൻ പ്രതിജ്ഞ പാലിച്ചുവെന്നും, ദുര്യോധനന്റെ സ്വന്തം അനീതികളും മൈത്രേയന്റെ ശാപവും ഈ വീഴ്ച ന്യായമാക്കുന്നുവെന്നും കൃഷ്ണൻ വാദിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 9.59; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Jun 23 2020

verses.text: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच

meaning.en: Dhritarashtra said:

verses.text:
अधर्मेण हतं दृष्ट्वा राजानं माधवोत्तमः ।
किमब्रवीत्तदा सूत बलदेवो महाबलः ॥

meaning.en: Sanjaya, when Balarama, the great and mighty best of the Madhavas, saw the king struck down against dharma, what did he say then?

verses.text:
गदायुद्धविशेषज्ञो गदायुद्धविशारदः ।
कृतवान्रौहिणेयो यत्तन्ममाचक्ष्व संजय ॥

meaning.en: Tell me what the son of Rohini, who knew the finer points of mace fighting and was expert in it, did.

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
शिरस्यभिहतं दृष्ट्वा भीमसेनेन ते सुतम् ।
रामः प्रहरतां श्रेष्ठश्चुक्रोध बलवद्बली ॥

meaning.en: Seeing your son struck on the head by Bhimasena, Rama, best of fighters, grew very angry, strong as he was.

verses.text:
ततो मध्ये नरेन्द्राणामूर्ध्वबाहुर्हलायुधः ।
कुर्वन्नार्तस्वरं घोरं धिग्धिग्भीमेत्युवाच ह ॥

meaning.en: Then in the midst of the kings the plough-bearer raised his arms and cried out in terrible distress, saying "Shame, shame, Bhima!"

verses.text:
अहो धिग्यदधो नाभेः प्रहृतं शुद्धविक्रमे ।
नैतद्दृष्टं गदायुद्धे कृतवान्यद्वृकोदरः ॥

meaning.en: "Alas, shame that a blow below the navel was struck against a man of pure valour! This has never been seen in mace fighting, what Vrikodara has done."

verses.text:
अधो नाभ्या न हन्तव्यमिति शास्त्रस्य निश्चयः ।
अयं त्वशास्त्रविन्मूढः स्वच्छन्दात्संप्रवर्तते ॥

meaning.en: "The settled rule of the scripture is that one must not strike below the navel; but this fool, ignorant of the rule, acts as he pleases."

verses.text:
तस्य तत्तद्ब्रुवाणस्य रोषः समभवन्महान् ।
ततो लाङ्गलमुद्यम्य भीममभ्यद्रवद्बली ॥

meaning.en: As he spoke so, his great anger rose, and the strong one, lifting his plough, rushed at Bhima.

verses.text:
तस्योर्ध्वबाहोः सदृशं रूपमासीन्महात्मनः ।
बहुधातुविचित्रस्य श्वेतस्येव महागिरेः ॥

meaning.en: With his arms raised, that great-souled man looked like a great white mountain, many-coloured with its minerals.

verses.text:
तमुत्पतन्तं जग्राह केशवो विनयानतः ।
बाहुभ्यां पीनवृत्ताभ्यां प्रयत्नाद्बलवद्बली ॥

meaning.en: As he leapt forward, Keshava, bowed in humility, caught him, strong though he was, carefully with his two thick, rounded arms.

verses.text:
सितासितौ यदुवरौ शुशुभातेऽधिकं ततः ।
नभोगतौ यथा राजंश्चन्द्रसूर्यौ दिनक्षये ॥

meaning.en: The two best of the Yadavas, one white and one dark, then shone more brightly, O king, like the moon and sun in the sky at the end of day.

verses.text:
उवाच चैनं संरब्धं शमयन्निव केशवः ।
आत्मवृद्धिर्मित्रवृद्धिर्मित्रमित्रोदयस्तथा ।
विपरीतं द्विषत्स्वेतत्षड्विधा वृद्धिरात्मनः ॥

meaning.en: As if calming him in his fury, Keshava said to him: "Growth of oneself, growth of friends, growth of friends' friends, and the reverse of these for enemies: this is the sixfold kind of growth for oneself."

verses.text:
आत्मन्यपि च मित्रेषु विपरीतं यदा भवेत् ।
तदा विद्यान्मनोज्यानिमाशु शान्तिकरो भवेत् ॥

meaning.en: "When the opposite happens to oneself or one's friends, one should know it as a loss of heart and quickly make peace."

verses.text:
अस्माकं सहजं मित्रं पाण्डवाः शुद्धपौरुषाः ।
स्वकाः पितृष्वसुः पुत्रास्ते परैर्निकृता भृशम् ॥

meaning.en: "The Pandavas, of pure manliness, are our natural friends, our own people, sons of our father's sister, and they have been badly wronged by others."

verses.text:
प्रतिज्ञापारणं धर्मः क्षत्रियस्येति वेत्थ ह ।
सुयोधनस्य गदया भङ्क्तास्म्यूरू महाहवे ।
इति पूर्वं प्रतिज्ञातं भीमेन हि सभातले ॥

meaning.en: "You know that fulfilling a vow is a Kshatriya's dharma. Bhima vowed earlier in the assembly hall: 'In the great battle I shall break Suyodhana's thighs with my mace.'"

verses.text:
मैत्रेयेणाभिशप्तश्च पूर्वमेव महर्षिणा ।
ऊरू भेत्स्यति ते भीमो गदयेति परंतप ।
अतो दोषं न पश्यामि मा क्रुधस्त्वं प्रलम्बहन् ॥

meaning.en: "Long ago the great sage Maitreya also cursed him: 'Bhima will break your thighs with his mace,' scorcher of foes. So I see no fault; do not be angry, slayer of Pralamba."

verses.text:
यौनैर्हार्दैश्च संबन्धैः संबद्धाः स्मेह पाण्डवैः ।
तेषां वृद्ध्याभिवृद्धिर्नो मा क्रुधः पुरुषर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: "We are bound to the Pandavas by ties of marriage and affection; their rise is our rise. Do not be angry, bull among men."

verses.text: राम उवाच

meaning.en: Rama said:

verses.text:
धर्मः सुचरितः सद्भिः सह द्वाभ्यां नियच्छति ।
अर्थश्चात्यर्थलुब्धस्य कामश्चातिप्रसङ्गिनः ॥

meaning.en: Dharma, well practised by good people, is held back by the other two, wealth is held back by one too greedy for it, and desire by one too much attached.

verses.text:
धर्मार्थौ धर्मकामौ च कामार्थौ चाप्यपीडयन् ।
धर्मार्थकामान्योऽभ्येति सोऽत्यन्तं सुखमश्नुते ॥

meaning.en: One who does not harm dharma and wealth, dharma and desire, or desire and wealth, and who pursues dharma, wealth and desire together, enjoys happiness without limit.

verses.text:
तदिदं व्याकुलं सर्वं कृतं धर्मस्य पीडनात् ।
भीमसेनेन गोविन्द कामं त्वं तु यथात्थ माम् ॥

meaning.en: All this has been thrown into confusion by Bhimasena's violation of dharma, Govinda; but you may say to me whatever you please.

verses.text: वासुदेव उवाच

meaning.en: Vasudeva said:

verses.text:
अरोषणो हि धर्मात्मा सततं धर्मवत्सलः ।
भवान्प्रख्यायते लोके तस्मात्संशाम्य मा क्रुधः ॥

meaning.en: You are known in the world as free of anger, righteous, and always devoted to dharma; so calm down and do not be angry.

verses.text:
प्राप्तं कलियुगं विद्धि प्रतिज्ञां पाण्डवस्य च ।
आनृण्यं यातु वैरस्य प्रतिज्ञायाश्च पाण्डवः ॥

meaning.en: Know that the Kali age has arrived, and know the vow of the Pandava; let the Pandava be quit of his debt of enmity and of his vow.

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
धर्मच्छलमपि श्रुत्वा केशवात्स विशां पते ।
नैव प्रीतमना रामो वचनं प्राह संसदि ॥

meaning.en: Even hearing Keshava's argument of dharma, Rama, not pleased at heart, spoke in the assembly.

verses.text:
हत्वाधर्मेण राजानं धर्मात्मानं सुयोधनम् ।
जिह्मयोधीति लोकेऽस्मिन्ख्यातिं यास्यति पाण्डवः ॥

meaning.en: "Having killed the righteous King Suyodhana by unrighteous means, the Pandava will be known in this world as a crooked fighter."

verses.text:
दुर्योधनोऽपि धर्मात्मा गतिं यास्यति शाश्वतीम् ।
ऋजुयोधी हतो राजा धार्तराष्ट्रो नराधिपः ॥

meaning.en: "Duryodhana too, being righteous, will go to the eternal destination; Dhritarashtra's son, the king, was killed as a straight fighter."

verses.text:
युद्धदीक्षां प्रविश्याजौ रणयज्ञं वितत्य च ।
हुत्वात्मानममित्राग्नौ प्राप चावभृथं यशः ॥

meaning.en: "Entering the consecration of war and spreading out the sacrifice of battle, he offered himself into the fire of his foes and gained fame as his final bath."

verses.text:
इत्युक्त्वा रथमास्थाय रौहिणेयः प्रतापवान् ।
श्वेताभ्रशिखराकारः प्रययौ द्वारकां प्रति ॥

meaning.en: Having said this, mighty Balarama, the son of Rohini, mounted his chariot and set off for Dvaraka, looking like a peak of white cloud.

verses.text:
पाञ्चालाश्च सवार्ष्णेयाः पाण्डवाश्च विशां पते ।
रामे द्वारवतीं याते नातिप्रमनसोऽभवन् ॥

meaning.en: When Rama had gone to Dvaravati, O king, the Panchalas, with the Vrishnis, and the Pandavas were not in good spirits.

verses.text:
ततो युधिष्ठिरं दीनं चिन्तापरमधोमुखम् ।
शोकोपहतसंकल्पं वासुदेवोऽब्रवीदिदम् ॥

meaning.en: Then Vasudeva said this to Yudhishthira, who was wretched, deep in worry, face lowered, his resolve crushed by grief.

verses.text:
धर्मराज किमर्थं त्वमधर्ममनुमन्यसे ।
हतबन्धोर्यदेतस्य पतितस्य विचेतसः ॥

meaning.en: "King of dharma, why do you approve of an unrighteous act, in the case of this fallen man, bereft of kin and out of his senses?"

verses.text:
दुर्योधनस्य भीमेन मृद्यमानं शिरः पदा ।
उपप्रेक्षसि कस्मात्त्वं धर्मज्ञः सन्नराधिप ॥

meaning.en: "Why do you look on, O king, while Bhima tramples Duryodhana's head with his foot, you who know dharma?"

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
न ममैतत्प्रियं कृष्ण यद्राजानं वृकोदरः ।
पदा मूर्ध्न्यस्पृशत्क्रोधान्न च हृष्ये कुलक्षये ॥

meaning.en: Krishna, it does not please me that Vrikodara touched the king's head with his foot in anger, nor do I rejoice at the ruin of my family.

verses.text:
निकृत्या निकृता नित्यं धृतराष्ट्रसुतैर्वयम् ।
बहूनि परुषाण्युक्त्वा वनं प्रस्थापिताः स्म ह ॥

meaning.en: "We were always cheated by the sons of Dhritarashtra with their fraud, and after many harsh words were sent away to the forest."

verses.text:
भीमसेनस्य तद्दुःखमतीव हृदि वर्तते ।
इति संचिन्त्य वार्ष्णेय मयैतत्समुपेक्षितम् ॥

meaning.en: "That sorrow weighs heavily in Bhimasena's heart; thinking so, Varshneya, I let this pass."

verses.text:
तस्माद्धत्वाकृतप्रज्ञं लुब्धं कामवशानुगम् ।
लभतां पाण्डवः कामं धर्मेऽधर्मेऽपि वा कृते ॥

meaning.en: "So, having killed this foolish, greedy man, who followed his desires, let the Pandava have what he wants, whether it was done in dharma or in adharma."

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
इत्युक्ते धर्मराजेन वासुदेवोऽब्रवीदिदम् ।
काममस्त्वेवमिति वै कृच्छ्राद्यदुकुलोद्वहः ॥

meaning.en: When the king of dharma had spoken, Vasudeva, the chief of the Yadava line, said this, reluctantly: "Let it be so."

verses.text:
इत्युक्तो वासुदेवेन भीमप्रियहितैषिणा ।
अन्वमोदत तत्सर्वं यद्भीमेन कृतं युधि ॥

meaning.en: So addressed by Vasudeva, who wished Bhima well, Yudhishthira approved all that Bhima had done in the battle.

verses.text:
भीमसेनोऽपि हत्वाजौ तव पुत्रममर्षणः ।
अभिवाद्याग्रतः स्थित्वा संप्रहृष्टः कृताञ्जलिः ॥

meaning.en: Bhimasena, too, having killed your son in the fight, in his anger, bowed and stood before Yudhishthira, delighted, with joined palms.

verses.text:
प्रोवाच सुमहातेजा धर्मराजं युधिष्ठिरम् ।
हर्षादुत्फुल्लनयनो जितकाशी विशां पते ॥

meaning.en: Highly radiant, his eyes wide with joy and full of the pride of victory, he said to Yudhishthira, the king of dharma, O lord of men:

verses.text:
तवाद्य पृथिवी राजन्क्षेमा निहतकण्टका ।
तां प्रशाधि महाराज स्वधर्ममनुपालयन् ॥

meaning.en: "Today the earth is yours, O king, peaceful, its thorns removed; rule it, great king, following your own dharma."

verses.text:
यस्तु कर्तास्य वैरस्य निकृत्या निकृतिप्रियः ।
सोऽयं विनिहतः शेते पृथिव्यां पृथिवीपते ॥

meaning.en: "The man who caused this enmity, who loved deceit and cheated by fraud, lies here killed on the earth, O lord of the earth."

verses.text:
दुःशासनप्रभृतयः सर्वे ते चोग्रवादिनः ।
राधेयः शकुनिश्चापि निहतास्तव शत्रवः ॥

meaning.en: "Duhshasana and the others, all those fierce speakers, and Radheya and Shakuni, your enemies, are dead."

verses.text:
सेयं रत्नसमाकीर्णा मही सवनपर्वता ।
उपावृत्ता महाराज त्वामद्य निहतद्विषम् ॥

meaning.en: "This earth, filled with jewels, with its forests and mountains, has come back to you, great king, now that your enemies are slain."

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
गतं वैरस्य निधनं हतो राजा सुयोधनः ।
कृष्णस्य मतमास्थाय विजितेयं वसुंधरा ॥

meaning.en: The enmity has ended and King Suyodhana is dead; this earth has been won by following Krishna's counsel.

verses.text:
दिष्ट्या गतस्त्वमानृण्यं मातुः कोपस्य चोभयोः ।
दिष्ट्या जयसि दुर्धर्ष दिष्ट्या शत्रुर्निपातितः ॥

meaning.en: By good fortune you have freed yourself from the debt of your mother's anger and of your own; by good fortune you have won, invincible one, and your enemy has been struck down.
